title: What If Eve Never Ate the Forbidden Fruit?

scenes.image: Extreme close-up of a shiny red fruit hanging from a branch, the Serpent curled around the branch leaning toward the camera with a sly grin.
lines: [smooth, oily] One bite... and you'll know everything.

scenes.image: Eve on a crowded balcony looking at the Serpent with a flat, unimpressed face, arms crossed.
lines: [flat, unimpressed] Do you know why my rent went up?

scenes.image: The Serpent beaming with delight, holding up a tiny inspection checklist.
lines: [delighted] Twelve percent! And your branch is due for inspection.

scenes.image: Eve squinting suspiciously at the Serpent.
The Serpent unrolling an enormously long lease scroll that tumbles down the tree trunk and keeps going.
sfx: Long paper scroll unrolling with a comic whoosh

scenes.image: Wide shot revealing the Tree of Knowledge rebuilt as a towering, wobbly treehouse apartment complex with dozens of crammed balconies, laundry lines and ladders, a neighbor on an upper balcony shaking a dusty rug onto a man eating breakfast on the balcony below.
sfx: A rug being beaten and a frying pan clatter

scenes.image: A bright cartoon title card over a golden garden, a gold coin dropping out of a big letter O.
lines: [storybook, warm] Nine hundred years earlier, the serpent made Eve the very same offer.

overlay.text: WHAT IF EVE NEVER ATE|THE FORBIDDEN FRUIT?

scenes.image: The same branch with the red fruit in an empty, peaceful, untouched Garden of Eden, the Serpent leaning toward Eve.
lines: [smooth] One bite... and you'll know everything.

scenes.image: Eve narrowing her eyes at the Serpent, one eyebrow raised.
lines: [narrowing her eyes] How much does it cost?

scenes.image: The Serpent grinning far too widely, sweating slightly.
Eve leaning back, deeply suspicious.
lines: [suspicious] Then why are you talking like that?

scenes.image: Eve walking away into the garden while the Serpent stares after her, puzzled.
Adam cheerfully dragging a huge log past the tree, pointing at an empty branch.
lines: [cheerful, oblivious] Hey! Can I put a shelf here?
sfx: A heavy log scraping across grass

scenes.image: The Serpent looking at Adam, then at the many empty branches, his pupils turning into little gold coins.
Adam happily hammering a single small shelf onto the giant empty tree as the Serpent holds out a contract and a quill.
lines: And that is how the first lease was signed.

scenes.image: A sunny Garden of Eden filled with happy families, babies everywhere, new treehouse floors going up on every tree.
lines: In this Eden, nobody ever ate the fruit. So nobody ever left. People grew up, but nobody grew old. Babies kept coming. And so did the second floors.

scenes.image: Eve setting a little wooden chair in a perfect square of sunlight at the foot of the crowded tree, smiling.
A new balcony swinging out right above Eve, casting her chair into shadow, Eve looking up furious.
lines: [furious] HEY! You just built over my sun!

scenes.image: Adam leaning over the new balcony railing above, surprised and waving.
Eve staring up in disbelief.
Adam proudly gesturing around his tiny balcony, a woman's deck visible directly above him.
lines: [proud] Since breakfast! The woman above me put in a deck.

scenes.image: A woman on the deck above Adam, hands on hips, defensive, pointing upward.
lines: [defensive] I HAD to! The man above me got a goat!

scenes.image: A man on a very high balcony shouting down with cupped hands.
lines: [shouting down] HALF a goat! My brother has him on weekends!

scenes.image: Two neighboring balconies, a small white cartoon goat with a brown patch over one eye stretched across the gap so the same goat's head pokes over both railings.
Eve climbing a rickety ladder up the crowded tree toward a sunny landing, determined.
lines: So Eve climbed. And every time she reached a sunny landing...

scenes.image: Eve reaching a sunny landing just as a new floor slams into place above her, plunging her into shadow, Eve furious.
lines: ...somebody built a new floor over it.
sfx: Three wooden CLUNKs in a row

scenes.image: At the very top of the tree, the Serpent lounging beside an empty deck chair in full sun with a sand timer, Eve arriving panting.
lines: [panting, furious] There you are. MOVE. THE CHAIR. I just want to sit in the sun!

scenes.image: The Serpent sweetly holding up the sand timer.
Eve outraged, arms thrown wide.
lines: [outraged] You're charging me for the SUN?!

scenes.image: The Serpent smugly patting the chair.
lines: [patient, smug] The sun is free. You're paying for the chair.

scenes.image: Eve sitting on the floor beside the chair as the Serpent opens a parasol over her head, blocking the sun.
lines: [through gritted teeth] How much to close that?

scenes.image: The Serpent beaming proudly like a teacher.
lines: [proud] Look at you. Asking the right questions!

scenes.image: A long, winding line of people stretching across the garden, some sleeping in line, one holding a sign.
lines: By the third century, the waiting list had a waiting list.

scenes.image: Adam hanging a big wooden sign at the garden gate that reads EDEN IS FULL, a very pregnant woman tapping his shoulder.
lines: [desperate] My baby's due TODAY. Where do I put him?

scenes.image: Adam turning with a polite, clueless smile, holding a tiny clipboard.
lines: [polite, clueless] Do you have a reservation?

scenes.image: The pregnant woman staring at Adam in stunned silence, Adam sweating nervously.
lines: [nervous] Right. Of course. Uh... how small are we thinking?

scenes.image: A tired older neighbor handing Eve a cracked clay token marked with a big number.
lines: [weary] Is this still good? I've been waiting for a ground-floor unit since I was thirty.

scenes.image: Eve looking sympathetic, holding the clay token.
lines: [sympathetic] Oh no. How old are you now?

scenes.image: The neighbor's completely deadpan face, close-up.
Eve turning to Adam, exasperated, pointing across a small sparkling creek to an empty green meadow.
lines: [exasperated] Why don't we just build on the OTHER side of the creek?!

scenes.image: Adam earnestly explaining, hands raised.
lines: [earnest] I asked the serpent. He said it's too dangerous to cross on foot.

scenes.image: Eve leaning in, slow and suspicious.
lines: [slow, suspicious] Did he say that before... or AFTER he started selling boat tickets?

scenes.image: Adam looking down at an enormous teetering stack of boat tickets in his arms.
Eve dangerously calm, one eye twitching.
lines: [dangerously calm] How many did you buy?

scenes.image: Adam proudly holding up the ticket stack, then shrinking.
lines: [proud, then shrinking] Enough to make it a very good deal.

scenes.image: The bow of a huge wooden ark backing slowly into the garden past the trees, people jumping aside.
lines: And then the ark backed into the garden.
sfx: A huge ship horn then truck reversing beeps

scenes.image: The middle of the enormous ark's hull still sliding past the trees, endless planks.
Still the middle of the ark's hull, even longer, people sitting down to wait.
A giraffe on the ark's deck popping up from under a clothesline wearing three pairs of shorts around its neck.
Noah at the ark's ramp holding a clipboard, a crowd led by Eve and Adam arriving carrying chairs, beds and a bathtub.
lines: [gruff, bored] All right. Two of every kind.

scenes.image: Adam excited, waving his tickets.
Noah flat and unimpressed.
The whole crowd slowly turning to stare at Adam, who quietly lowers his stack of tickets.
lines: [to Noah] How many tickets did you actually sell him?

scenes.image: Noah checking his clipboard.
Adam confused, scratching his head.
lines: [confused] I thought that meant we could stand!

scenes.image: Noah pointing to a spot on the grass one step farther from the ramp.
lines: [pointing] It means you can stand... right there.

scenes.image: Adam indignant, pointing at the ark.
lines: [indignant] Fine! What about the mosquitoes? Give me THEIR seats!

scenes.image: Noah shrugging, pointing behind Adam.
lines: You can ask. They're behind you.

scenes.image: Two snooty cartoon mosquitoes in tiny hats pulling a tiny suitcase past the line.
lines: [tiny, high-pitched, snooty] Excuse us. We checked in online.

scenes.image: Adam outraged, pointing at the mosquitoes flying up the ramp.
Noah completely deadpan.
lines: [deadpan] The giraffes can walk. I'm trying to make this fair.

scenes.image: a small white cartoon goat with a brown patch over one eye on the ramp happily chewing the passenger list while Eve narrows her eyes at Noah.
lines: [narrowing her eyes] Noah. How deep is the creek today?

scenes.image: Noah puffing out his chest proudly.
lines: [proud] Deep enough to float my boat.

scenes.image: The huge ark grinding against a rock in a tiny shallow creek, everyone wincing.
sfx: A long slow wooden scraping groan

scenes.image: A tiny cluttered treehouse apartment, Adam stuffing a bathtub into a travel bag, Eve throwing up her hands.
lines: [hurt] You said pack the things that are hard to replace!

scenes.image: Eve shouting, pointing out the window at the creek.
lines: [small] The boat guy says we can't use it.

scenes.image: Eve crouching to look at stone clay tablets wedged under a wobbly table leg.
Eve horrified, holding up the clay tablets.
lines: [horrified] You're using the LEASE to hold up the TABLE?!

scenes.image: Adam proudly patting the wobbly table.
lines: [proud] It's the only thing in this house with a lifetime guarantee!

scenes.image: The table tilting, a fig rolling off and out the window, the Serpent outside catching it with his tail.
sfx: A crash and a comic catching pop

scenes.image: The Serpent sliding a fresh notice under the door that reads RENT +12%.
lines: [smug] Oh, and twelve percent. Starting Monday.

scenes.image: Eve staring at the notice, realizing, the opening scene's branch visible through the window.
lines: [wry] And that brings us back to where we started.

scenes.image: Eve standing firm, arms crossed, facing the Serpent at the window.
lines: [sweet] I'll need Adam's permission. He signed for the whole tree.

scenes.image: Eve slowly turning her head toward Adam with an icy stare.
lines: [slowly turning] Adam. Why did you sign for the WHOLE TREE?

scenes.image: Adam defensive, holding up his hands.
lines: [defensive] It was just a shelf at the time!

scenes.image: Eve leaning in.
Adam brightly holding up a small plain wooden bowl like a trophy.
Eve shoving the wooden bowl at the Serpent.
The Serpent examining the bowl with a jeweler's loupe.
lines: [examining it] You've had it for three hundred years. I'll have to charge for wear.

scenes.image: Eve snatching the bowl back and storming out the door, Adam calling after her.
lines: [calling after her] Where are you going?!
[determined] To find somebody who remembers who planted this tree!

scenes.image: At the giant roots of the tree, Eve pulling an old brass handbell out of the moss beside a mossy stone plaque.
lines: At the very bottom of the tree, under nine hundred years of moss, Eve found something.

scenes.image: Adam nervously peering at the bell over Eve's shoulder.
lines: [nervous] Eve, I think that's for REAL emergencies.

scenes.image: A bathtub smashed into the grass exactly where Adam was standing, Adam one step to the side, frozen, hair standing up.
sfx: A long falling whistle then a big comic crash

scenes.image: Eve ringing the brass bell, the whole crowded tree frozen mid-motion, thunder clouds rolling in far away.
Noah on the ark's deck far away, shouting triumphantly with his hands cupped.
lines: [from the dock, triumphant] I TOLD you it was gonna rain!

scenes.image: Eve shouting back across the garden.
lines: [shouting back] You told me the END was near!

scenes.image: Noah shouting back.
Light rain, every balcony of the tree draining onto the one below, a man on the lowest floor calmly opening an umbrella indoors without looking up.
lines: [wry] It barely drizzled. But on a tree with four hundred floors, it rained on the bottom for a week.

scenes.image: The garden gate, the Serpent at a little booth with a cash box and his best smile, only a pair of glowing sandals visible stepping up.
lines: [salesman voice] Two figs to get in!

scenes.image: Close-up of the glowing sandals and the hem of a white robe at the gate.
lines: [calm, warm, slightly amused] I made this garden.

scenes.image: The Serpent not missing a beat, grinning.
lines: [without missing a beat] Then you remember when it was free!

scenes.image: God stepping into frame softly glowing, kind and calm, while Adam slowly hides a wooden bowl behind his back.
Eve pointing furiously from God to the Serpent.
lines: [pointing, outraged] You said we couldn't eat from ONE tree! How did HE end up owning it?!

scenes.image: God calm and firm, hand raised gently.
The Serpent hissing a whisper behind his tail, a man far above holding a pen over a contract.
lines: [hissed whisper] Could you say that a little quieter? I'm signing somebody for the top floor.

scenes.image: God looking up patiently at the towering tree.
lines: [patient] Adam. How many floors did you put on that tree?

scenes.image: Adam thinking very hard, counting on his fingers.
God leaning back, then stepping back, squinting up at a tree so tall it disappears into the clouds.
God catching a falling wooden shutter with a little hanging sign.
The Serpent proudly presenting the shutter like a real estate agent.
God peeking through the shutter's opening, a man right on the other side brushing his teeth, foam everywhere.
lines: [mouth full of foam, annoyed] Do you MIND?!

scenes.image: God handing the shutter to Adam, kind and tired.
lines: [kind, tired] Adam... you know there's land on the other side of the creek, right?

scenes.image: Adam confident, pointing at the giant ark.
Adam gesturing grandly at the enormous ark sitting in the tiny creek.
lines: [as if it's obvious] Look at it! He built a boat THAT big. You don't build a boat that big for a little creek!

scenes.image: Noah poking his head over the ark's rail, helpful.
lines: [helpful] I built it on a hill. Adam paid extra to have it brought here.

scenes.image: Eve slowly turning to glare at Adam, who looks defensive.
lines: [defensive] The delivery was free! We paid to turn it AROUND.

scenes.image: a small white cartoon goat with a brown patch over one eye trotting down the ark's ramp toward the creek with the passenger list in its mouth, Noah chasing.
a small white cartoon goat with a brown patch over one eye stepping into the creek, everyone on the bank holding their breath.
lines: [hushed] Everyone held their breath. The water came up...

scenes.image: a small white cartoon goat with a brown patch over one eye standing in the creek with the water barely reaching its knees, looking bored.
a small white cartoon goat with a brown patch over one eye on the far bank happily munching grass in a wide, sunny, empty meadow, the whole crowd staring from the other side.
lines: [very quiet, very dangerous] Adam. Did you ever check how deep it was?

scenes.image: Adam shrinking to a tiny size in embarrassment.
Eve exploding with rage, steam coming out of her ears.
lines: [exploding] You asked the guy SELLING THE BOAT TICKETS?!

scenes.image: God hitching up his robe and wading across the shallow creek, the pregnant woman following holding her shoes.
lines: [hopeful] Can we just... live over here?

scenes.image: God turning, smiling warmly.
The pregnant woman suspicious.
The old neighbor dropping his cracked clay token into the creek, then fishing it back out.
lines: [deadpan] I waited a long time for that.

scenes.image: The whole crowd stampeding across the shallow creek in a giant splash, carrying beds and chairs.
sfx: A huge crowd running and splashing through water

scenes.image: Two people on the far bank holding a door upright between them, each politely gesturing for the other to go first.
lines: [amused] Some habits take longer to leave.

scenes.image: Eve in her little chair in the middle of a wide-open sunny meadow, eyes closed, face lifted to the sun, blissful.
Adam setting the bathtub down beside Eve's chair with a thud, beaming.
lines: [eyes still closed] Why did you bring that?

scenes.image: The Serpent sliding in with a tiny potted cutting of the tree and a little sign that reads GARDEN VIEW 2 FIGS EXTRA.
God walking up, frowning at the potted cutting.
God stern, arms crossed.
The Serpent looking down at the plant, then up at God, brightening.
The Serpent holding out a contract to God, Adam reaching for the pen, Eve with eyes still closed plucking the pen out of Adam's hand.
lines: [amused] Eve never even opened her eyes.

scenes.image: God sitting on the edge of Adam's bathtub in the meadow, watching the crowd and the impossibly tall tree across the creek, tired.
lines: [tired sigh, to himself] Maybe she should've just eaten the fruit.

scenes.image: A wobbly dreamy thought bubble: Eve biting the red fruit, thunder, Adam and Eve walking out of the garden gate heads down into a wide empty wilderness.
lines: [dreamy, smiling] Everybody leaves. Quiet garden. No balconies. No goat...

scenes.image: Inside the thought bubble, just past the garden gate, a huge billboard reading EAST OF EDEN LUXURY CONDOS, the Serpent in a hard hat waving at Adam and Eve.
The thought bubble popping, God staring blankly into space.
a small white cartoon goat with a brown patch over one eye bleating right into God's ear, God wincing.

youtube.title: What If Eve Never Ate the Forbidden Fruit? | A Bible Story Reimagined
youtube.description:
In this Eden, nobody ever ate the forbidden fruit. So nobody ever left... and nine hundred years later, the Garden is FULL. The serpent is the landlord, Adam signed a lifetime lease, Noah is selling boat tickets, and Eve just wants five minutes of sun.

A funny animated Bible story, reimagined.
